body:
## Waning moon. A steady day of practice.

Rose with the bell. Sipped the morning potion of water before the coffee incantation, **which held my focus until noon**. The rituals went as written:

- Ten pages read from the tome
- A walk through the grey, the river still as glass
- A message cast home

> Worthy of a proud flourish: walking when the weather whispered otherwise. Consistency is the oldest magic.
